title: Design System: Pi Durable Assistant UI

headline.purpose: The opening question in an empty conversation.

title.purpose: The desktop header; compacted to 13px on mobile.

body.purpose: Readable message prose using the system sans-serif stack.

label.purpose: Supporting labels and compact text actions.

code.purpose: Monospace code blocks and tool details.

motion.name: sidebar-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile sidebar movement; transition is none under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Send actions use a filled charcoal button.
components.css: .ds-send { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-send:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-send { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #171717; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-send:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #383838; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Native conversation actions use a light bordered button.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-secondary { border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; background: #fff; color: #171717; font-size: 12px; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--muted); }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Message actions remain compact and visually secondary.
components.css: .ds-text { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-text { border: 0; padding: 3px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--secondary); font-size: 12px; } .ds-text:hover { color: #171717; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Native field
components.description: Configuration fields retain visible labels and browser form behavior.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-field-label > span { color: var(--secondary); font-size: 12px; } .ds-field { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #fff; color: #171717; font: inherit; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Conversation navigation
components.description: Conversation rows use tonal hover and selected states.
components.html: <nav class="ds-navigation" aria-label="Conversations"><button class="ds-conversation" type="button">Conversation 1</button><button class="ds-conversation ds-conversation-active" type="button">Conversation 2</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-conversation { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-conversation:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-conversation:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-navigation { background: #fafafa; padding: 8px; } .ds-conversation { display: block; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; padding: 11px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; background: transparent; color: #171717; font-size: 14px; } .ds-conversation:hover { background: #eee; } .ds-conversation-active { background: #e9e9e9; font-weight: 550; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The active textarea uses the enclosing composer border as its focus indicator.
components.css: .ds-composer-send { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-composer-send:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-composer-attach { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-attach:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-composer-attach:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-composer { padding: 15px 16px 12px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #525252; } .ds-composer-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 28px; max-height: 180px; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #171717; caret-color: #171717; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-composer-input:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-composer-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-composer-attach { border: 0; padding: 3px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--secondary); font-size: 12px; } .ds-composer-attach:hover { color: #171717; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-composer-send { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #171717; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-composer-send:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #383838; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-composer { padding: 12px 13px 10px; } }

components.name: Reasoning disclosure
components.description: Native details keep supporting content available within the thread.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { margin: 10px 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: #505050; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-disclosure summary { padding: 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reasoning { padding: 0 14px 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: User message
components.description: A muted bubble distinguishes the user message from assistant prose.
components.html:
You
Help me plan a small task.
components.css: .ds-user-message { margin: 0 0 30px 15%; min-width: 0; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #171717; } .ds-user-label { margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: right; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-user-content { padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-user-message { margin-left: 8%; } }

components.name: Human input panel
components.description: Agent questions remain inline with a labeled response field.
components.html:
Pi needs your input

Which task should I work on?
components.css: .ds-human-input button { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-human-input button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-human-input button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-human-input { margin: 12px 0; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: #fafafa; color: #171717; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-human-input h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-human-input p { margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-human-input label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--secondary); } .ds-human-input textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 85px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px; color: #171717; background: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-human-input textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-human-input button { margin-top: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #171717; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-human-input button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #383838; }

components.name: Attachment
components.description: Attachments stay compact with a truncating filename and a remove action.
components.css: .ds-attachment-remove { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-attachment-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #525252; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-attachment-remove:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-attachment { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 8px 12px 0; padding: 7px 10px 7px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: #171717; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; } .ds-attachment-name { max-width: 160px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-attachment-remove { border: 0; padding: 3px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--secondary); font-size: 12px; } .ds-attachment-remove:hover { color: #171717; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Preserve the familiar conversation list, thread, and composer selected in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md). The interface is quiet, compact around controls, and spacious around messages. Native Pi capabilities fit into this chat composition through disclosures and ordinary form controls.

The implementation in [styles.css](apps/demo/src/styles.css) and the demo components defines the visual system. The tokens here record its reusable values; they are not a separate theme implementation. Functional clarity and predictable browser behavior guide additions.
keyCharacteristics: Grayscale surfaces, dark primary actions, and restrained semantic color.
A centered conversation column with persistent access to the composer.
Native disclosures and labeled controls for detailed operations.
Responsive wrapping, contained overflow, and visible keyboard focus.
dos: **Do** keep the conversation list, thread, and composer as the primary composition.
**Do** extend existing Assistant UI primitives and native browser controls with the same neutral styling.
**Do** keep labels, status text, focus indicators, wrapping, and contained overflow when adding controls.
donts: **Don't** replace the selected standard chat style with a decorative visual identity.
**Don't** make color the sole indicator of status or errors.
**Don't** present deterministic provider responses as real model output.
